messages:
zoe: Quick note from design review: the credentials page has a few discoverability/accessibility problems that keep popping up in sessions — mainly around copy, reveal and the empty state layout.
omar: Saw that too. Two concrete things: 1) Copy and reveal are buried behind the kebab on narrow widths, 2) Empty state CTA is below the security banner so people miss it.
claire: Proposal: make Copy a primary affordance on the row (icon button visible on focus & hover). Keep Reveal as a separate action that opens a short-lived modal. Do NOT reveal on hover.
zoe: +1. Also add a visible keyboard focus ring on the copy action and ensure it's reachable via Tab. For power users we can add a single-key shortcut (press "K") to copy when a row is focused, but it must be documented.
devex: If we add a shortcut, include a small inline hint when a row receives focus: "Press K to copy" that disappears on blur. Also add the shortcut to the global shortcuts modal.
security-bot: Shortcut rule: shortcuts that trigger a reveal must respect org policy. For orgs with `mfa_reveal_required` the shortcut should open the reveal modal (not copy the secret directly). All reveal/copy events must be audited with actor+method.
a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: for the reveal modal use `role=dialog` and focus trap. When the modal opens announce "API key revealed" via `aria-live=assertive` and include a visually hidden label with the key name. For copy success, use `role=status` with `aria-live=polite` saying "API key copied to clipboard".
claire: Empty-state change: move primary CTA above the security banner and introduce a concise subheading: "Create API credential" -> shorter copy like "Create key" might be clearer. Banner should be collapsible and not steal initial focus.
zoe: Also microcopy tweak for revoke: current text is generic. Recommend: "Revoke credential — immediately invalidates existing tokens. You can undo for 30s." Add an explicit Undo button in the toast and make it keyboard-focusable.
omar: Bulk actions: do not reveal multiple secrets in the UI. For bulk-rotate/export, default to download-only with a typed-confirm toggle to include secrets. Warn inline with a red outline and typed confirm like "EXPORT SECRETS".
security-bot: Agreed. Downloads that include secrets require typed confirm and MFA if org policy demands it. Log device fingerprint on download.
a11y-bot: Also ensure color is not the only signal for warnings; include icons and text. On small screens move banners below the CTA so the primary action is visible.
claire: Implementation checklist I'll add to the ticket: 1) inline copy button visible on focus + hover 2) single-key shortcut (K) when a row is focused + shortcut modal entry 3) reveal opens modal with TTL 30s and assertive announcement 4) empty-state CTA above collapsible banner 5) revoke undo toast with keyboard focus and 30s TTL 6) bulk export typed-confirm for secrets 7) audit logs for reveal/copy/downloads.
zoe: I'll update the Figma mocks to show the copy hint and the CTA reorder. Omar can take the keyboard story and add tests. Claire will own the accessibility checklist and microcopy.
omar: I'll add e2e keyboard tests and ensure the shortcut respects the org flags. Planning to gate behind `creds_shortcuts_v1`.
zoe: Thanks team. Acceptance criteria: copy reachable by mouse+keyboard, reveal requires explicit modal with announcement, empty-state CTA prominent, downloads require explicit confirmation, and all sensitive actions are audited. :white_check_mark:
